## Project structure

```
my_paper/
├── _quarto.yml       # project config
├── index.qmd         # manuscript (text only)
├── analysis.qmd      # all R code
├── data/
│   ├── raw/          # NEVER modify
│   └── derived/      # output of analysis.qmd
├── outputs/figures/  # figures from analysis.qmd
├── references/references.bib
└── README.md
```

## Day 1 setup

```r
# Set up renv
install.packages("renv")
renv::init()
renv::snapshot()
```

Then in Positron:

1. Source Control → **Initialize Repository**
2. Stage all → Commit → **Publish to GitHub** (Public)
3. zenodo.org → Settings → GitHub → toggle repo ON

## Daily workflow

In Positron Source Control panel:

1. Work in `analysis.qmd` and `index.qmd`
2. Click **+** to stage changed files
3. Write commit message → click **tick** to commit
4. Click **Sync** to push to GitHub

## Before submission

1. zenodo.org → New Upload → fill metadata → **Reserve DOI**
2. Add to manuscript:

```
Data available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.XXXXXXX
(upon acceptance) and https://github.com/user/repo
```

## After acceptance

1. Final commit: `"final version — accepted by [Journal]"`
2. Sync to GitHub
3. GitHub → Releases → **Create release** → tag `v1.0` → Publish
4. zenodo.org → find draft → **Publish**
5. Update data availability statement (remove "upon acceptance")

## renv commands

```r
renv::init()        # set up renv in a new project
renv::snapshot()    # update lockfile after installing packages
renv::restore()     # install packages from lockfile (for reproducibility)
```

## Render order

Always render in this order if analysis has changed:

1. Render `analysis.qmd` → updates figures in `outputs/`
2. Render `index.qmd` → uses updated figures
